headline: Mooring County Ignites Under Heavy Assaults While Expanse Lines Shift
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, the focal point of battle has shifted dramatically to Mooring County, where savage skirmishing erupted over Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Wind Hills. Nearly 4,000 casualties fell across the county in two hours, leaving Warden forces in possession of nine strategic bases against two Colonial strongholds and one neutral ruin. In Marban Hollow, violent back-and-forth clashes broke out at Checkpoint Bua across eleven recent exchanges, leaving Colonials holding six bases, Wardens one, and one ruined. To the east, Colonials reclaimed two previously devastated positions in Weathered Expanse, broadening their control to six bases against a solitary Warden outpost and two neutral sites despite enduring more than 3,400 combined casualties in two hours. A sudden flare of combat in Olavis Wake claimed nearly 1,700 lives over Koskinla, reducing one base to no-man's-land among four Warden positions. Meanwhile, the bloodletting in Callahan's Passage has cooled markedly without further territorial shifts, though casualty rates surged along the Nevish Line and into Linn of Mercy.
